tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las: khro bo dam pa bsdus pa'i lam: sgrub thabs snying por bsdus pa bzhugs:

he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: khro bo kun gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil: thabs mchog srid pa'i tshul nyid du: gnas skabs chu bo bzhi sbyang ba: ting 'dzin rim pa bstan par bya: sa ma ya: de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi: dang po dben par dkyil 'khor bsham: sgrub rten gsang ba'i tshogs mchod bcas: rgyud sbyang yan lag brgyad pa bya: rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgom: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐: hūm̐: yang dag lta ba'i ngang nyid las: khro bo'i sprin kun 'phros pa yis: bgegs dang log 'dren tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus rdo rje'i gur khang che: me rlung chu yi rim pas bskor: sus kyang gzhom du med par bsam: badz+ra raṃ yaṃ khaṃ rak+ṣa: bshags yul spyan drangs dpang gsol te: hūm̐: ye nas gnyis med chos skur dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin: de ldog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: dam bca' brtan po bzung nas su: hūm̐: kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi: byang chub mchog tu bdag ni sems bskyed do: don dam dang ni kun rdzob byang chub sems: bla ma lha khyod rtag tu bzung bar bgyi: rgyas par brjod med bshags pa dang: dam bca' nyi shu la sogs bya: mos gus gdung bas byin chen 'bebs: hūm̐ a la la ho: bha ga wān sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mthu chen bdud thul bcom ldan 'das: byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byin bsdus phyi nang mchod pa rnams: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus: bdud rtsi'i snod ni gzhal yas khang: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir dam rdzas bcu: sa bon phyag mtshan rigs lnga'i sku: yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsir zhu: bhan+dha bdud rtsir oṃ gyis mtshan: rgya gram rta mgrin yum bzhis mnan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sbyor ba'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi bskul: 'od zhu bdud rtsir dbyer med 'dres: gtor gzhong bhan+dha'i nang du ni: gtor ma oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: pad+ma bhañdza'i snod nang du: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: snod mchog zhing khams phun tshogs pa: mchod pa lha mo'i rol par bsam: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga dhū pe dhū: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+pe pu: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga gan+dhe gan: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni: hūm̐: 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing: gdug pa srid gsum 'dul ba dang: nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir: sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom: hūm̐: chos rnams skye med spros dang bral: 'gag med ye shes kun tu khyab: stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pa'i: rang rig hūm̐ sngon 'bar bar gyur: rdo rje rgyu yi he ru ka: thugs nas e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ: raṃ bh+rūm̐ 'phros pas nam mkha'i klong: 'thor rlung khrag mtsho zhing gi sa: keng rus ri rab me chen 'bar: dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus: 'khor lo thod pa'i gzhal yas khang: dregs pa byol song zhing gi gdan: lha chen mgo dang tsit+ta'i tog: phyi nang rim gnyis me dpung 'khrugs: khrag zhags 'bab cing 'jigs su rung:

gru chad 'khor lo'i dbus rtsibs la: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ru dra dri za gshin rje srin: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol gdan la: dom dang khyu mchog ma he dang: gzig dang rta ni zung gi khrir: rgyu yi khrag 'thung dbus su 'khod: dbu dang phyag mtshan bsam yas pa: khro mo dbyings phyug ma dang rol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐: byang chub sems sprin khro bo'i tshogs: mkha' khyab spros nas dregs pa btul: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje khro bo khrag 'thung mthing: khro mo dbyings phyug 'du 'bral med: dkar dmar zhal du nyon mongs 'dren: rtse dgu rtse lnga ti ra dang: dril bu dung dmar 'jig rten 'chang: shes rab 'khyud pas chags pa ston: bud+dha khro bo khrag 'thung smug: bud+dha khrag 'thung khro mo 'khril: dkar ser smug nag gti mug 'dren: 'khor lo rdo rje ti ra dang: dril bu dung dmar tri shūl 'chang: rat+na khro bo khrag 'thung ser: rat+na khrag 'thung khro mo 'khril: sngo dmar ser nag nga rgyal gsol: rin chen rdo rje ti ra dang: dril bu dung dmar dgra sta 'dzin: pad+ma khro bo khrag 'thung dmar: pad+ma khrag 'thung khro mo 'khril: dkar ser dmar nag 'dod chags gsol: pad+ma rdo rje ti ra dang: dril bu dung dmar rnga chung rdung: karma khro bo khrag 'thung ljang: las rab khro mo khrag 'thung 'khril: dkar dmar ljang nag phrag dog gsol: rgya gram rdo rje ti ra dang: dril bu dung dmar thod gshol 'dzin: zhabs bzhi rol pa'i gar dgu ldan: dur khrod chas gsol dpal gyi gzi: yum rnams dril bu dung dmar stobs: kun kyang sbyor ba'i byang sems las: ha: rtsibs mchan gru chad rnam brgyad la: gau rī bhan dmar zhing dbyug sngo: tsau rī mda' gzhu 'geng ma ser: pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar: bai tā byis pa ro 'phyar nag: puk+ka dmar ser byis rgyu 'dren:

ghasma dung dmar dkrugs 'thung ljang: sme shā mthing nag byis snying za: tsan+dhā ser skya mchog lus phral: he: 'bar ba'i gser khyams ser po ru: siṃ ha kha ro bsnol ser seng: byā ghṛ mnan stabs bsnol dmar stag: sṛ la nag mo byis ldag wa: shwa na 'dral lta mthing ga spyang: gṛḍha gri dmar rgyu 'dren rgod: kaṅka zhing 'phrag snar mgo ring: kā ka kha ro bhan gri nag: ū lu lcags kyu mthing tshogs 'ug: phaṭa: pho brang nang ma'i sgo bzhi la: rta gdong sngon mo lcags kyu 'dzin: phag gdong nag mo mche zhags 'dzin: seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom: spyang gdong ljang nag dril 'khrol dgyes: kun kyang khro mo dur khrod chas: zhing rlon gdan la gar gyis rol: 'khor ba'i 'dzin lus phyir thon te: hūm̐ ho: zhes bskul kun sbyor sems sprin gyis: rtog sgrib kun sbyang 'od du zhu: gser zhun lta bu'i thig ler gyur: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs: yi ge gsum ni hūm̐ du 'dus: zla ba la gnas rlung gis bskyod: lha tshogs bskor nas gtso bo yi: thugs kar thim pas yab yum rol: sku yi dbyibs brgyud yum mkhar gnas: bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis ni: gtso 'khor ma lus 'od du zhu: 'od kyi phung po gcig tu gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐: yi ge phyag mtshan lha ru gyur: spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum sbyor: chu yis sgrib sbyang dbang bskur nas: yab yum rigs lngas dbu yang brgyan: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā dar+sha dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā sa mā tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā kṛ t+yā nuṣ+ṭhā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gnas lngar zla ba pad+ma dang: nyi ma rin chen rgya gram la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod:

ye shes lnga rnams bsdus nas thim: rigs lnga yab yum sku ru gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: yab gsang hūm̐ las rdo rje dbus: oṃ dkar bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag: yum mkha' paṃ las pad+ma'i gdan: oṃ dmar ge sar es mtshan gyur: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sa ma ya ho: ra ho haṃ: a nu rā ga ya mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sbyor ba'i byang chub sems sprin gyis: rgyal ba kun bkug bde bas zhu: sku yi dbyibs brgyud gsang bar babs: yum gyi mkha' la lan gsum spros: yan lag bzhi yi tshul du rdzogs: rten dang sa bon bcas par gyur: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: khrag 'thung dbyings phyug khro mo dang: phra men sgo ma bcas su gyur: phaṭa dza: rim bzhin phyir phyung mdun mkhar bzhugs: spro bsdus sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsgrubs: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: kun kyang rang rang gdan la 'khod: bh+yo: thugs nas bh+yo yig nyer brgyad 'phros: khrag khyams bar dang phyi sgo ru: srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang: tshangs ma dmar ser pad+ma bsnams: sna chen dkar ljang tri shū la: gtogs 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'chang: gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thunga'adzin: brgya byin dkar mo in+d+ra gdengs: rdo rje ser mo tsan+dan 'thung: bdud rtsi dmar mo pad+ma bsnams: zla ba dkar mo puṇ+ḍa 'dzin: be con ljang nag dbyug pa phyar: srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung: za ba ljang nag ba su 'dren: dga' ba dmar mo ka tar phyar: stobs chen dkar mo gshol mda' 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo spu gris gcod: 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs: nor srung dkar mo bum pa 'dzin: rlung lha sngon mo ba dan phyar: gsod byed dkar mo ral gri 'dzin:

me mo dmar mo gsal shing phyar: phag gdong nag mo mche zhags can: rgan byed dmar mo zhing chung za: sna chen dkar ljang thod khrag 'thung: chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin: rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo ra mgo zhags: rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog bsnams: rdo rje ljang nag dril 'khrol dgyes: zhing lpags gos gsol thod rgyan can: zhing rkyang keng rus gdan la rol: kun kyang rigs kyi dbu rgyan dang: ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa: drag po rtse gsum rnams kyis mtshan: ngo bo ro gcig ma 'dres pa: dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub gyur: rang rig hūm̐ sngon rtag 'char bas: 'od kyis chos dbyings kun khyab nas: chos sku gzugs kyi sku ru bzhengs: oṃ: phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che: dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las: dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs so: rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas: phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi: bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs: nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: e h+ye hi ā na ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: nye bar drangs nas dbyer med rig: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya ho: bstims nas snyan bskul dbang du bya: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: gsal byas phyag mchod bstod 'bul ni: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: 'gro don rdzogs bar bzhugs par bsam: de nas phyag mchod bstod pa ni: lha la lha rol tshul gyis ni: a ti pu ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: spro na phyag rgya bzhi yis mchod: hūm̐ oṃ: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā:

yang dag don du dag mod kyang: 'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du: phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang: rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gdugs kyis 'gebs: byams pa thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra dhū pe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga dhū pe dhū: ut+pal mthing ga me tog 'thor: sna tshogs rin chen 'od du 'phro: snying rje thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra puṣ+pe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hū: sa ma yo ta muḥ sarba ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+pe pu: dbang gi phyag na sgron me bsnams: chos kyi rgyal po 'bar ba 'dzin: dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra ā lo ke'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: tsan+dan bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma: dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'bebs: btang snyoms thabs dang shes rab las: badz+ra gan+dhe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga gan+dhe gan: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa'i: bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar: dug lnga sel ba sman gyi mchog: rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: khams gsum chags pa'i 'dzin pa bsgral: chags med chags bral dmar chen po:

dug gsum rnam par sbyong ba'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha rnams bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta pra tīts+tsha khā hi: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa: ye shes lnga yi mchod sprin che: byin rlabs gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di: mchod do bzhes shig dgyes par mdzod: ma hā ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs shes mnyam sbyor bde chen sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun mchod de: 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog thams cad bsgral: mnyam nyid spros bral ye mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bo dhi tsit+ta s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: dharma dhā tu shud+dha ā: hūm̐: gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu ba bzhin: mche ba zangs yag za byed che ho: hūm̐: rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir: gtum chen ri rab 'bum bsnyil skad: a la la yi gad rgyangs che: bshugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che ho: hūm̐: khro bo shes rab 'od po che: ye shes dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal: 'bar ba'i ye shes kun tu 'joms: sna tshogs ye shes thig le che ho: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po sprin chen po: 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor char chen 'bebs: dkyil 'khor ye shes 'byung ba'i gter: sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che ho: hūm̐: bdud kun gyi ni bdud chen po: bdud kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'joms: 'jigs pa'i tshogs kyang 'jigs byed pa: 'jigs byed chen po thig le che ho: hūm̐: rdo rje brag chen sra ba po: rdo rje chu ste sdud chen po: rdo rje me ste kun 'bar che: rdo rje rlung ste 'thor rlung che ho:

spro na mchod pa bcu drug 'bul: bshags shing dam bca' dngos grub gsol: de nas 'dzab kyi rim pa ni: mkha' khyab dkyil 'khor chen po ni: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: sems dpa' sum brtsegs gsal ba yi: dper na shel ltar 'tsher ba yi: 'od zer phar 'phros sgrib sbyang bskul: tshur 'phros rtog sgrib ma lus sbyangs: dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod du gyur: 'od zer dmar po rā ga'i mdangs: phar 'phros ye shes mchod cing bskul: tshur 'phros dngos grub rnam pa gnyis: 'od zer tshul du bdag la thim: sngags sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar: grags stong brjod bral rang sgrar grags: mthing zhun lta bu'i 'od zer ni: phar 'phros rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul: tshur 'phros dngos grub chen po ni: bdag la bstsal zhing brtan par mdzad: ye nas gnyis med lhun grub pa'i: lhag pa'i chos sku chen por 'grub: yab yum zhal nas zhal du zhugs: mkha' nas mkhar drangs bde ba che: lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid: sa lam dus gcig der rdzogs gyur: phyag rgya sku mchog yi ge 'bru: phyag mtshan shin tu phra ba'i gzugs: mtha' yas spro bsdus don kun mdzad: lhag pa'i ting 'dzin 'byongs pa'i tshad: rlung sngags sems gsum dbyer med pa: rdo rje'i bzlas pa mchog tu bshad: ru lu sngags kyi dbyangs chog bya: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: yang na so so'i sngags bzlas nas: bstod pa'i rim pa rgyud bzhin bya: de tshe rtags kyi rim pa yang: blo stobs dbang gis rgyud bzhin 'grub: rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod ni: ma da na dang māṃ sa sogs: bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon bsang chus sbyang: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor bkrus: rnam par rtog pa dmigs med dbyings: ma las nyi ma'i snod yangs par: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā rnams las: ye shes lnga yi 'dod yon sprin: bla na med pa'i tshogs su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang:

dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan 'dren gyi: dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru: zhing chen gsar rnying ri ltar spungs: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil: ma lus bzhes shing bsnams su gsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: e h+ye hi ā na ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mchod pa'i rim pa ci yang spro: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'di: thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha ho: hūm̐: tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad: ngag gis tshig rtsub 'khyal smra ngan du brjod: sems kyis blo nor log par sems pa sogs: 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad brtsam: nongs shing 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis mthol lo bshags: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs: yig brgya brjod la gzugs byang la: bden stobs brjod la dmigs bya bkug: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bskul byas na: sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig: bdud rtsi lnga dang zas lnga la: mtshan ma ming du bcas pa la: bkug ste rdo rje phur pas bsgral: rdul du brlags nas tshogs su 'bul: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: log 'dren bdud rtsir sbar nas 'bul: hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs mchod 'di: mchod sprin kun tu rgyas gyur cig: dug gsum brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du stobs: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi:

brda dang brda yi 'bul len gyis: longs spyod nang gi sbyin bsreg bya: glu gar grogs ldan 'chad nyan dang: dbang bskur sbyor bas nyams rtogs spel: lhag ma gsog 'jog med par bsdus: zhing la khrag gis maṇ+ḍal bri: phud lhag mar me sman raka bshams: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la: oṃ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom: zla ba la gnas gtor ma ni: oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro bar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod rgyal phyag rgya bshud pa'i sgras: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃḥ oṃ ḍā ki ā kar+ṣa ya: ā kar+ṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhan+dha ya: bhan+dha ya: to ṣa ya: to ṣa ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badz+ra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ḍāk+ki hūm̐ dza: 'dod pa'i las rnams byed par bsam: rta gdong snyems pas phyag rgya bya: hrīḥpad+ma ba ḍa bā mu kha: ā kar+ṣa ya: ā kar+ṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhan+dha ya: bhan+dha ya: to ṣa ya: to ṣa ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badz+ra ḍā ki nī naṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ha ha hi hi: dbang du 'dus shing bka' sdod bsam: mgron rnams rigs lnga'i tshom bu ru: bzhugs shing gtor ma bzhes par bsam: he ru ka yi thod rgya bya: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: bud+dha ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ta oṃ phaṭa: rat+na ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ta trām̐ phaṭa: pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hrīḥphaṭa: karma ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ta āḥphaṭa: gtor ma phud bcas sme bar blug: lce ni rta mgrin yab yum gnyis: sbyor ba'i byang sems dza gad kyi: kha phru dam rgyas 'beb par bya: oṃ gu ru kro dha rat+na sa ma ya pri sha sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pā la kro dha kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: bcom ldan dpal chen phud kyi bdag: bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod du: ma mo mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi bdag: tha ma lhag mas mi mchod du:

ma tshogs dbang phyug lhag ma'i gnas: lhag ma kha chus mi gdab rgyu: bran pho bran mo kha chu'i bdag: rnam gsum rim gyis mi mchod du: bka' dang gzhung lugs rim par yod: rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos kyi dbyings su tha mi dad: las rnams so sor mi bcol du: las kyi 'dul skal rim par yod: nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur ba'i: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: stong khams yongs la mnga' mdzad pa'i: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: srog dbugs kun la mnga' mdzad pa: skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad dang: rdo rje phra men rdzu 'phrul can: skyes bu laṅka drug cu dang: ta kṛta lcam du zhal bzhes pa'i: 'bar ma nyul le brgyad rnams dang: sha khrag zhal du gsol mdzad pa: dur khrod dregs pa'i ma mo bdun: rgyal chen sring mor zhal bzhes pa'i: sring mo chen mo bzhi rnams dang: phyogs bcur khyab par las byed pa'i: pho nya sum brgya drug cu dang: ri rab rmangs nas 'degs mdzad pa'i: dbang gi gru 'degs bzhi rnams dang: pha rol dmag dpung 'joms mdzad pa'i: dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo bzhi: dpal gyi bka' sdod khyed rnams kyis: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma longs: rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sman dang rak+ta gtor mas mchod: ho: lhag ma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phud dang lhag ma bzhes su gsol: dam tshig nyams chag skong bar mdzod: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub par mdzod: ya hi gats+tsha sa rang gnas gshegs: gtor ma mu ran bar du bskyal: hūm̐: lhag dkyil rang gi snying gar bsdu: srung ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bh+rūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor ma'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di longs la: zhal bzhes dam bca' de bzhin du:

sgrub pa'i sdong grogs phrin las mdzod: brtan ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab: trāṃ rat+na trai lo kya phaṭa: gtor ma rdul phran re re bzhin: rin chen gur khyim longs spyod gyur: 'bru gsum dag gis byin gyis brlab: yang dag zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i brtan ma ni: hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid: khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams: 'dir byon dam skong dngos grub stsol: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shān+ting dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ la lā: le le: taṃ taṃ: te te: kha rak+ma: ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: srung ma gats+tshaḥ sa gshegs par bya: gtor gzhong sbubs la bro yang brdung: yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes zhi ba chen po rnams: thugs rje chen pos bro brdungs pas: gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: nyon mongs bdud dang mi mthun tshogs: yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad pa'i: zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ngo mtshar brjid pa chen po rnams: rngams pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams: yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzad: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: waṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: bde ba chen po'i gar bsgyur rnams: chags pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas:

'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: rgyal blon pho mo 'bru nor rnams: yud tsam gyis ni dbang du sdud: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: ru dra dgra bgegs ma lus pa: yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzad: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtang rag mchod bstod nongs pa bshags: hūm̐: sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed de: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rnams: bdag la bstsal cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu: bdag la 'dus shing bdag nyid kyang: hūm̐ la 'dus shing mi dmigs gyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: slar yang bdag nyid he ru ka: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: badz+ra kā wā tsi rak+ṣa haṃ: spyi bo'i haṃ zhu rdo rje'i go: mdzub mo oṃ hūm̐ khro bo gnyis: snying kha lte ba ltag pa dang: dpral ba spyi bo'i gnas lnga ru: khro bo lu gu rgyud du gyur: hūm̐ truṃ: oṃ badz+ra ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ: dbu rgyan bkon la cod pan yang: oṃ ār+ya laṃ bho dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrī: mthing dmar 'phyang zhing 'phur bar bsam: yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya: shis par bya zhing dge ba bsngo: rtag tu ting 'dzin mi 'bral bar: snang srid dag pa chen po ru: 'gro ba'i don la spyod par bya: thabs des rig 'dzin bzhi gang rung: 'grub nas bla med sa mchog thob: de phyir rtse gcig nyams len bya: sa ma ya rgya rgya: kho bo mchog gyur gling pas nam mkha' mdzod nas spyan drangs shing zangs shog las zhal bshus pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
